links.comparator_used: First-generation DeepLab V3 system left in place (post-implementation cohort and Auto1-assisted contouring) versus the updated second-generation nnU-Net V2 system
links.outcome: Geometric agreement between unedited auto-contours and final treatment contours, failure rate, contouring time, inter-observer consistency, accuracy, and blinded clinical acceptability
links.effect: Mean DSC improved from 0.88 to 0.93 for CTV (P<0.001) and from 0.88 to 0.95 for OARs (P<0.001). Mean failure rate fell from 3.30% to 0.64% (about 80.6% reduction). Total contouring time was 16.97 vs 21.74 min (about 21.9% less than Auto1) and 41.15 min for manual. CTV inter-observer DSC was 0.95 vs 0.93. Mean Likert score was 4.02 vs 3.26 (P<0.001), with 95.2% vs 28.6% of contours scoring >=4.
links.quote: Auto2 demonstrated significantly better clinical acceptability than Auto1, with a higher mean Likert score (4.02 ± 0.25 vs. 3.26 ± 0.49, P < 0.001).

design_hint: post-deployment model update with quality assurance and clinician editing of auto-contours
